title: Camera 13
hook: I got trapped in a Pulsebox game. One of the cameras was watching ME

messages.text: Jay clicked play on Nightwatch... and woke up at a security desk. Twelve cameras. And one of them... was pointed at him.
messages.label: CASTELLAN BUILDING · 3:10 AM

messages.text: That's me. That camera... is right behind me.
On camera seven, in an empty office, a chair rolled across the floor. By itself.
milo i'm the security guard in NIGHTWATCH
after 4am something tall starts hunting you. black bar over its face. if you see it, HIDE. and hold your breath
Jay took the elevator down to the lobby. It stopped on floor three. The Castellan Building... doesn't have a floor three.
No no no, close! Close the doors! CLOSE THE DOORS!
Four AM. At the end of the hall, something stood up. Too tall. With a black bar where its face should be.
messages.label: 4:00 AM

messages.text: Jay dove into a locker and held his breath. The footsteps stopped. Right outside.
Don't breathe. Don't breathe. Don't breathe.
When it was gone, Jay checked the tapes. One showed him in a hallway he'd never seen... at 5:12 AM. It was only 4:30.
Jay ran. Down the stairs, across the lobby, out the front doors... and woke up at his desk.
messages.label: 5:00 AM

messages.text: milo... there were only 12 cameras right?
Then a new window opened on his computer. Camera thirteen. Jay's room.
Nightwatch and eight more horror games, free on Pulsebox. box.pulseform.org. It's a computer game site, so play it on a computer. And check your cameras.
